SourcesBox score, game stories and the drawn play

Box score from the Hawks' 113–106 win over the Milwaukee Bucks at Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee on Nov 15, 2026, from the CBS Sports box score and play-by-play and the Covers box score (they match on every player line), with game details from the Associated Press (via CBS Sports). All 113 Atlanta points and all 106 Milwaukee points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores add up to both totals: 37–18 Milwaukee after one, 55–53 Atlanta at the half, 87–80 after three. Team totals (field goals 38 of 87 to 37 of 96, threes 12 of 40 to 18 of 54, free throws 25 of 34 to 14 of 18, turnovers 17 to 20) are from the CBS box score. Points in the paint (38–32), fast-break points (25–14) and the biggest leads (Atlanta 13, Milwaukee 22) are from Covers; bench points are added up from the box score. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Sunday's games.

Milwaukee led by 22 early in the second quarter (AP; 40–18 on a Gary Trent Jr. three at 11:07, CBS play-by-play), and Atlanta outscored the Bucks 37–13 from there to halftime. Atlanta's 13-point lead came at 74–61 on an Onyeka Okongwu three in the third (CBS play-by-play). From 104–95, CJ McCollum scored Atlanta's last 9 points: two free throws, a step-back three with 2:12 left for 109–103, the step-back jumper with 17 seconds left and two free throws with 8 seconds left (CBS play-by-play). Kasparas Jakucionis scored a career-high 25 for Milwaukee (AP). Atlanta had lost two straight coming in; Milwaukee has lost 10 straight (AP). Atlanta plays at Oklahoma City on Wednesday, Nov 18 at 8:00 PM ET (AP; CBS Sports schedule).

The play of the game is an original illustration of CJ McCollum's step-back jumper with 17 seconds left that made it 111–106 (AP: "McCollum's jumper with 17 seconds left sealed the win"; the CBS play-by-play logs a two-point step-back jump shot, after Jalen Johnson's defensive rebound, with the score going from 109–106 to 111–106). The distance isn't reported, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from mid-range. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to McCollum's listed 6-foot-3 and 190 pounds (RealGM; Wikipedia), in Atlanta's road red with No. 3 (RealGM; Wikipedia). No wingspan from a reliable measurement is reported, so his arms are drawn at a 1.0 ratio. He has no approved look on file yet, so he is drawn in the kit with our default skin tone. It is an original silhouette with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
